description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to leave comments within the Orange HRM system. It extends a date range filter and adds specific filtering for leave IDs, including allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for filtering leave comments based on date range and leave ID, with sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Sets the default sort field to 'leaveComment.createdAt'.

methods.name: getLeaveId
methods.description: Returns the leave ID filter value.

methods.name: setLeaveId
methods.description: Sets the leave ID filter value.
